actor_awards.notes: One of the few actors to achieve the 'Triple Crown of Acting' (Oscar, Emmy, Tony). He won back-to-back Academy Awards for Best Supporting Actor for 'All the President's Men' (1976) and 'Julia' (1977). He was widely considered the premier interpreter of playwright Eugene O'Neill's work.

filmography.title: All the President's Men
filmography.role_description: The tough, supportive, and principled executive editor of The Washington Post who guides reporters Woodward and Bernstein.
filmography.plot: Two Washington Post reporters uncover the truth behind the Watergate scandal.

filmography.title: Julia
filmography.role_description: The famous mystery writer and mentor/partner to playwright Lillian Hellman.
filmography.plot: At the behest of an old friend, playwright Lillian Hellman undertakes a dangerous mission to smuggle funds into Nazi Germany.

filmography.title: Magnolia
filmography.role_description: A dying television producer seeking reconciliation with his estranged son in his final days. Robards' final film role.
filmography.plot: An epic mosaic of interrelated characters in search of love, forgiveness, and meaning in the San Fernando Valley.
filmography.awards: Screen Actors Guild: Nomination – Outstanding Performance by a Cast

filmography.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
filmography.role_description: A romantic, cynical bandit who is framed for murder and helps a widow protect her land.
filmography.plot: A mysterious stranger with a harmonica joins forces with a desperado to protect a beautiful widow from a ruthless assassin working for the railroad.

filmography.title: Melvin and Howard
filmography.role_description: The reclusive, eccentric billionaire who is rescued in the desert by a struggling milkman, leading to a contested will.
filmography.plot: A milkman claims to have a valid will from eccentric billionaire Howard Hughes, leaving him a fortune.

filmography.title: A Thousand Clowns
filmography.role_description: An eccentric, unemployed comedy writer who must conform to society's standards or lose custody of his nephew.
filmography.plot: A free-spirited, unemployed writer raising his nephew is forced by social workers to find a job and conform to a conventional lifestyle.
filmography.awards: Golden Globe: Nomination – Best Actor in a Motion Picture - Musical or Comedy

filmography.title: Philadelphia
filmography.role_description: The conservative senior partner of a law firm who fires a gay lawyer after discovering he has AIDS.
filmography.plot: A man with HIV is fired by his law firm because of his condition, and he hires a homophobic small time lawyer as the only willing advocate for a wrongful dismissal suit.

filmography.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
filmography.role_description: The cynical, alcoholic older son of a dysfunctional family, a role Robards was famous for playing on stage.
filmography.plot: A harrowing, autobiographical look at a day in the life of the dysfunctional Tyrone family, dealing with addiction and regret.
filmography.awards: Cannes Film Festival: Win – Best Actor

filmography.title: The St. Valentine's Day Massacre
filmography.role_description: The notorious Chicago mob boss who orchestrates the infamous hit on a rival gang.
filmography.plot: A historical recreation of the events leading up to the 1929 massacre of seven mob associates in Chicago.

filmography.title: Parenthood
filmography.role_description: The patriarch of the Buckman family, struggling with the failures of his youngest son.
filmography.plot: The Buckman family deals with the various stresses and joys of raising children across multiple generations.

filmography.title: Tora! Tora! Tora!
filmography.role_description: The commander of the U.S. Army forces in Hawaii during the attack on Pearl Harbor.
filmography.plot: A dramatization of the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor and the series of American blunders that allowed it to happen.

filmography.title: Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid
filmography.role_description: The Governor of New Mexico who hires Pat Garrett to capture or kill Billy the Kid.
filmography.plot: An aging lawman is hired by wealthy cattle barons to hunt down his old friend, the outlaw Billy the Kid.

filmography.title: The Night They Raided Minsky's
filmography.role_description: A burlesque comic and straight man working at Minsky's theater.
filmography.plot: An Amish girl travels to New York City in the 1920s to be a dancer in a religious pageant, but ends up at Minsky's Burlesque.

filmography.title: Any Wednesday
filmography.role_description: A wealthy businessman using a corporate apartment for an affair, whose secret is discovered by his junior executive and his wife.
filmography.plot: A businessman's tax dodge—keeping a mistress in an executive suite—is threatened when his wife and an underling discover the arrangement.

filmography.title: Isadora
filmography.role_description: The wealthy sewing machine heir who becomes one of Isadora Duncan's principal lovers and benefactors.
filmography.plot: A biographical film about Isadora Duncan, the pioneering American dancer who changed the face of modern dance.

filmography.title: Johnny Got His Gun
filmography.role_description: The father of the severely wounded soldier, appearing in his memories and dreams.
filmography.plot: A young American soldier in WWI is severely injured, losing his limbs and senses, and is kept alive as a medical curiosity while trapped in his own mind.

filmography.title: Comes a Horseman
filmography.role_description: A ruthless, wealthy cattle baron who tries to force two independent ranchers off their land.
filmography.plot: In the 1940s West, two ranchers face pressure from a powerful land baron who wants their property.

filmography.title: Crimson Tide
filmography.role_description: The head of the board of inquiry investigating the mutiny aboard the USS Alabama.
filmography.plot: On a US nuclear missile sub, a young First Officer stages a mutiny to prevent his trigger happy Captain from launching his missiles before confirming his orders to do so.

filmography.title: Max Dugan Returns
filmography.role_description: A charming ex-con who returns to the life of his estranged daughter with a suitcase full of stolen money.
filmography.plot: A struggling widow's life is turned upside down when her estranged, criminal father returns with a large sum of money and a terminal illness.

filmography.title: By Love Possessed
filmography.role_description: A brilliant but cynical lawyer whose life is bound to the protagonist's law firm.
filmography.plot: A lawyer's perfectly ordered life unravels when he discovers his partner's fraud and engages in an affair.

filmography.title: Divorce American Style
filmography.role_description: A divorced man paying crippling alimony who tries to set his ex-wife up with the protagonist.
filmography.plot: A couple decides to divorce after 15 years of marriage, leading to a chaotic exploration of the alimony system and the dating scene.

filmography.title: Murders in the Rue Morgue
filmography.role_description: The director of a Grand Guignol-style theatre whose actors are being murdered by a disfigured killer.
filmography.plot: In early 20th century Paris, an actor uses real acid in a play, disfiguring another actor, who later returns for revenge.

filmography.title: Raise the Titanic
filmography.role_description: The admiral overseeing the ambitious and highly classified operation to raise the sunken ocean liner.
filmography.plot: A massive operation is launched to raise the RMS Titanic from the ocean floor to recover a rare mineral needed for a defense system.

filmography.title: Something Wicked This Way Comes
filmography.role_description: The town librarian and father of Will, who must confront his own regrets to fight the sinister Mr. Dark.
filmography.plot: A mysterious carnival arrives in a small town, led by the sinister Mr. Dark, who grants wishes for a terrible price.

filmography.title: The Paper
filmography.role_description: The eccentric, demanding publisher of the New York Sun newspaper.
filmography.plot: A day in the life of a New York tabloid newspaper as the staff races to cover a sensational murder story before their deadline.
